historical_record.description: With one commissioner dissenting, the Recreation and Park Commission approved Sasaki, Walker Associates' final plans and specifications for the Buchanan Street Mall between Grove and Eddy Streets, a park the Redevelopment Agency had developed over two years for the children of the Western Addition A-2 project's housing.
